projectDetails.name: RealT
projectDetails.description: RealT is a real-estate tokenization platform that offers fractional ownership of income-producing properties via tokenized shares on blockchain.

topRisks.content: Missing CCSS certification leaves crypto custody controls unvalidated, increasing the risk of undetected security gaps.
The lack of a structured Bug Bounty program reduces proactive vulnerability discovery, raising the risk that attackers find issues first.

RealT temporarily paused distributions and trading for some tokenized real-estate properties due to banking and compliance frictions with fiat partners, underscoring operational and regulatory risks rather than on‑chain exploits.

reviews.text: RealT tokenizes real estate for fractional ownership. Launched in 2019, it offers rental income via blockchain tokens. In 2025, it focuses on U.S. properties. Rental revenues are paid in stablecoins.

RealT is a platform for tokenized real estate. It turns U.S. rental properties into on-chain tokens (each ERC-20 token represents a share of an LLC, limited liability company, owning a house). The investment platform is based on two chains (Ethereum and Gnosis) and investors earn USDC or xDAI by claim or automatically. It is also possible to auto compound your investment. In my opinion RealT is a great use case, letting small actors take part of real estate investment with the security of blockchain. Properties start around $50 in token form, making real estate accessible globally.

RealT is really cool in how it brings real estate onto the blockchain. I like that I can literally buy a fraction of a house and earn rent via crypto. It feels very practical some of their properties have offered double digit rental yields. My main gripe is that it’s still a small platform: there are only a few dozen properties tokenized, mostly in the US, and dealing with taxes fees can be a headache. So it’s interesting and tangible, but also quite complex for the average user.

RealT is a platform that tokenizes real estate, allowing users to buy fractional ownership of properties. Investors earn rental income through tokenized shares of real estate, with the benefits of blockchain’s transparency and accessibility.
